message.content: {"ranking": [{"id": "patch_1f207853dea8", "mechanism": "rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in NET_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with i_data when r_valid is false and low-power/invalid conditions apply"}, {"id": "patch_97ba2adecc6f", "mechanism": "rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in REG_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with w_data (which carries r_data) when r_valid is false"}, {"id": "patch_e9c2e7485e9b", "mechanism": "rhs_substitution on o_data assignment in NET_OUTPUT: replace constant 0 with w_data (r_data) when r_valid is false and low-power/invalid conditions apply"}, {"id": "patch_da55a60398f6", "mechanism": "condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify reset with i_valid so r_valid is not cleared during valid input"}, {"id": "patch_042f4158d3f0", "mechanism": "condition_gate on r_valid set condition: add i_reset check to prevent r_valid being set during reset"}, {"id": "patch_7790f6f01318", "mechanism": "condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify OPT_INITIAL with i_valid"}, {"id": "patch_ed69a2c357ce", "mechanism": "condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify reset with !o_ready"}, {"id": "patch_25df7630e139", "mechanism": "condition_gate on r_valid initial block: qualify OPT_INITIAL with i_reset"}], "explanation": "The simulation mismatches show o_data stuck at 0 when it should carry valid payload values (65, 253, 184, 143, 121). The highest-relevance candidates directly substitute the correct data signals (i_data or w_data/r_data) into the o_data combinational assignments where 0 is currently driven. patch_1f207853dea8 and patch_e9c2e7485e9b target the NET_OUTPUT combinational path; patch_97ba2adecc6f targets the REG_OUTPUT sequential path. The condition_gate candidates adjust r_valid control logic around reset and valid qualification, which may fix the valid/ready handshake that gates data flow, but they do not directly supply data to o_data and show lower structural coverage of the failure site."}
